answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 23410 Country: India Title: 1. If a baligh girl and boy do nikah without their parents is right or wrong 2.what is the meaning of 786? Question: 1. If a baligh girl and boy do nikah without their parents is right or wrong 2.what is the meaning of 786? Answer ID: 23410 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 990/990/M=1431) If the boy and girl are kufu (of match) and there is no reason of hurmat (impermissibility) between them i.e. razaat (fosterage relation) etc and nikah is done in the presence of legal witnesses, in this case nikah shall take place and will be valid. However a nikah done without the permission and consent of parents invites misfortune and impermanence; hence doing it without their permission is inappropriate and a cause of regret. (2) 786 is the number of Bismillah. It is allowed to be written at places where the fear of disgrace is involved. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
